synopsis: The booklet treats TRLs as useful vocabulary but weak measurement: component maturity does not establish integration, data, model credibility, scenario coverage or safety-argument maturity, so it recommends TRLs only for genuinely novel elements and NASA-STD-7009B credibility assessment for the simulation toolchain [f9430, f9432, f9433, f14691]. Heavy-off-road maturity must not be inferred from automotive maturity; NIOSH's 2022 review found predominantly component/prototype evidence, only 8% of articles above TRL7, and little operational evidence for complete systems despite commercial availability [f458, f393, f5172, f6378]. MOSH requires independent verification at TRL4 and TRL7, no false interventions or false warnings at TRL4, and extended production monitoring at TRL9—for example, three months or 2,000 hours; its surface CPS TRL7 specification is dated 20 January 2026 [f2459, f2119, f5797, f557]. Hexagon announced on 25 March 2026 that its current-generation Vehicle Intervention System had passed Pretoria TRL4 verification before integrated site testing, but capability-building and verification durations were not found [f1350, f1846]. Immaturity at commitment is identified as the most consistently documented schedule-failure cause, while South African regulation illustrates readiness-policy tension: Regulation 8.10 was suspended in 2015 for unavailable technology, and collision-prevention clauses entered force in December 2022 despite a 2019 finding of immaturity [f9424, f10457, f2891]. Full-scale heavy-machine VIL maturity remains uncertain, and the booklet treats it as emerging and capital-intensive rather than a proven shortcut; the cited 2024 finding of no industrial-ready full-scale platform is specifically on-road evidence [f5765, f13401, f5340].
